description: This file contains the implementation of spiderfying and unspiderfying marker clusters in Leaflet, including animated and non-animated versions, as part of the Leaflet.markercluster plugin.

classes.name: L.MarkerCluster
classes.description: Class handling spiderfying behavior for marker clusters, including animated and non-animated versions.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterNonAnimated
classes.description: Subclass of L.MarkerCluster providing non-animated spiderfying behavior.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterGroup
classes.description: Leaflet marker cluster group extended with spiderfying control methods.

methods.name: spiderfy
methods.description: Triggers spiderfying of the cluster's child markers, arranging them in a circle or spiral.

methods.name: unspiderfy
methods.description: Reverses spiderfying, returning markers to their original positions.

methods.name: _animationSpiderfy
methods.description: Handles animated spiderfying of child markers, including SVG path animations.

methods.name: _animationUnspiderfy
methods.description: Handles animated unspiderfying, reversing the spiderfying animation.
